method: Installed native STM32CubeMX quiet CLI: config load followed by config saveas for each final reference. No interactive GUI inspection.
firmware_package_note: Selected project metadata only. No firmware package was installed for this audit and no code was generated.
annotation_mode: GPIO_Analog placeholders solely to retain physical-net labels, not operating configuration.
limits: No graphical pinout review or board interaction was performed.
Initial load by orderable part suffix6 returned KO; actual creation used the accepted STM32H743VITx database name and resulting CPN is STM32H743VIT6.
CubeMX can exit0 after KO, so command responses, file existence, reference identity, and roundtrip entries were checked.
The labels summarize physical drawings; full shared-net, bridge-state, power/reset and per-contact evidence belongs to maintained audit JSON.
Background catalog/advertising warnings from CubeMX do not establish pin or electrical validation.
